recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If OO wants future search behavior for workflow-adheresTo or workflow-triggeredBy extension use, handle that as new workflow-extension/search-parameter work rather than restoring the removed Observation.instantiates search parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-39312 was an Applied/Persuasive OO request to add an Observation search parameter for the then-new Observation.instantiates field so Observations could be searched by the ObservationDefinition they instantiate.
initial_application: FHIR-30791 first added Observation.instantiates[x] in commit 9481fec585. FHIR-39312 was then applied by commit 8b9d2cf5ab, which added Observation-instantiates-reference and Observation-instantiates-canonical to source/observation/bundle-Observation-search-params.xml, later merged through PR #3185 via c17c7c1424/b359f30ac3.
additional_context: FHIR-43456 later resolved as Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 to remove trial-use Observation.instantiates[x] and use workflow instantiation extensions instead. Its comments explicitly directed removal of instantiates-canonical and instantiates-reference search parameters, and commits 5003b4ef48 and a96b49f958 removed the element and search parameters. FHIR-32896 later resolved no-change because repeatability concerns were overcome by that workflow-extension removal path. FHIR-43456 is already represented on the combined branch by cbedd54f4f188091be23b91500a561c43c895e18.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The latest combined branch has no authoritative Observation.instantiates[x] element and no Observation instantiates search parameters; source/fhir.ini records the R5-to-R6 removal and workflow-pattern-extensions remains active. Re-adding the FHIR-39312 search parameters would target a removed element and conflict with the later applied workflow decision.
